evidence.finding: The internal Electron bridge exposes Git, PTY, files, agent hooks, automation, PR lookup, clipboard and state persistence. No public CLI, HTTP API, SDK, MCP, webhook, issue tracker or team service is exposed.

evidence.title: Constellagent desktop/src/main/pty-manager.ts
evidence.locator: PtyManager create/write/destroy/list/reattach and process event handling
evidence.finding: Local node-pty processes inherit the host environment. Per-PTY replay buffers and sequence numbers support reattachment while the process exists. Claude, Codex, Pi and Crush activity integrations do not implement agent delegation.

evidence.title: Constellagent desktop/src/main/git-service.ts
evidence.locator: GitService createWorktree, createWorktreeFromPr, stage, unstage, discard and commit
evidence.finding: Git worktrees and branches separate code. Missing .env files are copied into new worktrees. Git commit calls git commit directly without a product-owned test or review gate.

evidence.title: Constellagent desktop/src/main/automation-scheduler.ts
evidence.locator: AutomationScheduler schedule, executeRun, catchUpOnWake and unschedule
evidence.finding: node-cron schedules a Claude command in a new local worktree and terminal. A per-automation lock skips overlapping runs until PTY exit. Unschedule removes the cron job; it does not terminate an active PTY.

evidence.title: Constellagent desktop/src/main/ipc.ts
evidence.locator: STATE_SAVE, STATE_LOAD, sanitizeLoadedState and full registered handlers
evidence.finding: App state is saved to constellagent-state.json under Electron userData. Loading removes workspaces whose directories no longer exist. The handlers expose no user accounts or shared-server control plane.

evidence.title: Constellagent desktop/src/main/index.ts
evidence.finding: The app uses Electron BrowserWindow with a React renderer. macOS window minimum is 900 by 600. Wake events trigger automation catch-up.

evidence.title: Constellagent desktop/src/main/github-service.ts
evidence.locator: GithubService getPrStatuses, listOpenPrs, getAuthToken and GraphQL queries
evidence.finding: The app reads GitHub PR state, review decisions, checks and unresolved thread counts using gh authentication. It does not expose PR creation, merge, release or deployment mutations.

evidence.title: Constellagent desktop/src/main/notification-watcher.ts
evidence.finding: The watcher consumes local turn_started and awaiting_user event files with success or failed outcomes, publishes activity and deletes processed files. This is transient UI state, not a retained audit trail.
